# Changelog

## 0.15.36

- Added to Syncfusion BoldCreate Plugins from [cursor/plugins](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack) at commit `4dd1d05`. Skill and agent text is unchanged. For BoldCreate Connect, which installs each skill folder on its own, the `docs/` guide now sits inside the `poteto-help` skill that links to it, and the Cursor-only `automations/` pack and the extra root `plugin.json` are left out (both are linked upstream).
